{{Top|leg}}
'''Arkle Tellaro''' was a criminal and [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] who participated in a [[Velx-Shel raid|raid]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Velx-Shel]]. Hunted by [[Corellian Security Forces|CorSec]], Tellaro hid on a deserted tropical island on a civilized planet and relaxed in the [[Star/Legends|sun]] for several [[Standard month/Legends|months]]. Eventually, Tellaro left the hiding place due to needing to fly in space and spend the money. Tellaro was caught by CorSec and interrogated.<ref name="HS">''[[Hideouts & Strongholds]]''</ref>
